question.de: Finde Ajeltake im westlichen Teil des Majuro-Atolls.

question.ro: Găsește Ajeltake în partea vestică a atolului Majuro.
question.en: Find Ajeltake in the western part of Majuro Atoll.

question.de: Klicke Ebeye, Jabor und Arno von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Ebeye-ra, Jaborra és Arnóra nyugatról keletre.

question.en: Click Ebeye, Jabor and Arno from west to east.
